sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, raw x/y, fill colour) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/royal-caribbean/radiance-of-the-seas/v2496/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one .cabinShape[data-cabin] element per stateroom (rect, plus polygon/path for irregular suites). Category legend built by matching each fill colour to Royal Caribbean stateroom categories, cross-checked against cruisedeckplans.com category counts and CruiseMapper's total (1,071 staterooms).

notes.completeness: FULL grid: every stateroom on every guest deck (decks 2,3,4,7,8,9,10). Decks 5,6,11,12,13 carry no staterooms in the source (public rooms, dining, pool, Viking Crown). Total 1071 matches deckmaps' advertised per-deck counts and CruiseMapper's stated 1,071 staterooms. cruisedeckplans.com lists 1,061 across its marketed categories; the ~10 extra are accessible/guarantee/single cabins deckmaps draws but that list omits.
notes.category: deckmaps encodes category only via cabin fill colour. 25 distinct fills map to 9 Royal Caribbean categories (several categories use more than one colour shade). Per-colour assignments were cross-checked by count against cruisedeckplans.com: Interior 243 (exact), Ocean View 245 (vs 235 listed +Ultra-Spacious split), Ultra Spacious Ocean View 6 (exact), Balcony 512 (RC markets this as Balcony 368 + Spacious Balcony 145 = 513; kept as one Balcony bucket, not split per-cabin, to avoid mislabelling individual staterooms), Junior Suite 37 (vs 36), Grand Suite-1BR 17 (exact), Grand Suite-2BR 4 (exact), Owners Suite 6 (exact), Royal Suite 1 (exact). See colorLegend.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Each deck SVG is a vertical ribbon: the long axis is Y (fore-aft), the ~50-unit axis is X (beam). Bow direction resolved from RC numbering (low cabin numbers sit at low Y) => low Y = forward. section = forward/mid/aft thirds of each deck's Y span. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED heuristic. Geometric split of the beam (X) at each deck's median into two rows labelled port/starboard. RC does not use a clean odd/even split here, so parity was not used. The port/starboard labels could be uniformly mirrored; validate against a known cabin before relying on side. Inside cabins near the centreline are assigned by the same split and are the least certain.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps SVGs carry no obstructed-view flag; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction, not asserted as clear-view).
